description: LukeEvansTech shared Renovate config — home-operations/renovate-presets plus house defaults. Consume it from any repo with: extends: ["github>LukeEvansTech/renovate-config"].

customManagers.description: Track the doco-cd GitOps controller pinned inside Butane (.bu) provisioning files. On the FCOS boxes (seedbox, cr-nut) the doco-cd container that actually runs is launched by a systemd docker-run unit written in the .bu, NOT by any compose file Renovate reads — so without this the controller version silently drifts. Renovate has no native Butane manager, so extract the image tag by regex and resolve it as a docker dependency (digest pinned via docker:pinDigests like everything else).

packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor/patch everywhere after a 2-day soak — CI-gated PR merge. platformAutomerge:false means Renovate self-gates on CI and self-merges, so no branch-protection ruleset is needed, and repos with zero CI checks never auto-merge (Renovate requires ignoreTests:true to merge without tests). Majors never match any rule here, so they always stay manual. Repos add their own protected-package denylist (automerge:false, last-match-wins) for anything that must stay human-reviewed.

Auto-merge digest and pin updates — CI-gated, deliberately NO minimumReleaseAge: mutable-tag digest bumps reset the age clock on every upstream rebuild and GHCR often has no per-digest timestamp, so an age gate leaves digest PRs pending forever (talos-cluster had 11 pending up to 19 days).

GitHub Actions minor/patch/digest merge as a branch (no PR at all when clean; a failure surfaces as a PR). Action refs are SHA-pinned semver via the base preset, and a broken workflow bump shows up on its next run on main.

Never pin the codelooks-com/terraform-workflows reusable workflows that are tracked on @main. The two Azure Terraform repos (terraform-azure-platform, terraform-azure-workloads) reference standard-ci/-cd/-drift at @main on purpose: their GitHub OIDC subject includes job_workflow_ref, so the Azure federated credentials only trust a token whose sub ends in .../standard-*.yaml@refs/heads/main. SHA-pinning the ref rewrites that claim to @<sha>, no federated credential matches, and every plan/apply/drift run fails auth with AADSTS700213 (already reverted once in terraform-azure-workloads #18). Scoped to currentValue main so the other repos that pin standard-* to a @<sha> # vX.Y.Z tag keep their normal version-bump flow.
mise tool bumps minor/patch merge as a branch, same rationale as GitHub Actions above.

Terraform/Terragrunt-managed deps never auto-merge: in the codelooks-com IaC repos a merge to main auto-applies via CD, so provider/module bumps stay human-reviewed. Actions and mise bumps in those repos still auto-merge via the rules above.

doco-cd is the GitOps controller that deploys every stack — a bad bump breaks the deployer itself and can't self-heal, and its authoritative pin usually lives in a Butane (.bu) unit that only takes effect on a box re-provision. Never auto-merge it (overrides the container rules above, last-match-wins) and group every doco-cd update — the bootstrap compose and the .bu pin — into a single manual PR so both files move together.
